trap.label: causa x efeito
trap.wrong: Because of the storm, as a result the roads closed.
trap.right: The storm hit; as a result, the roads closed.
trap.why: O brasileiro mistura causa e efeito. As a result/therefore indicam efeito; because/due to indicam causa.

fix.wrong: The roads closed because of the storm hit.
fix.right: The roads closed because the storm hit.
Due to the storm, roads closed.

fix.wrong: It rained, therefore, but the match went on.
fix.right: It rained; however, the match went on.

rewrite.prompt: Use because: “The storm hit. The roads closed.” (…because…)
rewrite.answer: The roads closed because the storm hit.

rewrite.prompt: Use as a result: “The storm hit. The roads closed.”
rewrite.answer: The storm hit; as a result, the roads closed.

rewrite.prompt: Use due to: “The roads closed because of the storm.”
rewrite.answer: The roads closed due to the storm.
